# Vendored frontend dependencies

Runtime assets are pinned and served locally; the application makes no CDN requests.

- Bootstrap CSS 5.3.8 — layout and accessibility foundation only.
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — client metric history charts only.
- Tabler Icons Sprite 3.45.0 — interface icon sprite.
- Simple Icons 16.27.0 — provider marks.

Original licenses are stored beside the corresponding package directory.
